name: Deck Overview
author: Kyle-Hosman
summary: Every deck on one page: loaded or not, BPM, file name, and the BPM difference to a reference deck you pick.
description:
Adds a page under Mod Menu > Community Mods > Installed > Deck Overview listing each deck in the current view (2 or 4): whether a track is loaded, its BPM, and its file name.

Pick a reference deck with the browse knob or a tap, and every other deck shows how far its BPM is from it, in BPM and in percent. Anything the deck does not report is shown as "--", never guessed.

It only reads deck state through the AZ-MODS core. It does not patch the deck's code, change any control, LED or audio, write files of its own, or use the network.
